current.text: He left the Lakers and joined Philadelphia this offseason.

He is in Philadelphia's projected starting five with Maxey, Edgecombe, Jaylen Brown and Embiid. Nick Nurse calls him an offense creator, and it is reported he will play point guard and set up everyone else.
Josh expects a modest rise in his on-ball role, with maybe 8 assists a game, but no big change in how he plays.
He shares the ball with Maxey, Embiid and Jaylen Brown, and experts expect these stars to cut into each other's usage.
He will turn 42 this season. Experts expect him to sit some games and play about 65 games, and the team is expected to load manage its stars.
He has always wanted to play big minutes, and Nurse, who gives his starters heavy minutes, may let him.
Philadelphia has only 13 back-to-backs, which helps a little with his rest risk, but three of them fall in the fantasy playoffs.
Philadelphia is projected for about 51 to 52 wins, with growing pains expected in October and November.
One expert projects him as a top 30 player per game in category leagues.
Josh is okay drafting him in some situations but would pay no more than 25 USD. He went for 22 USD in an auction mock.

Experts disagree on his price around pick 40. One calls his tier about right, another says ADP 41 is too high, and one says pick 16 is far too early. In round 5 and the 50s, experts see him as good value.

durable.text: His numbers stay about the same each season. His scoring slowly drops, but he keeps the ball in his hands at a similar rate.
He gets far more assists than other forwards. His turnovers are a weak league outlier.
He ranks higher in points leagues than in category leagues.

note: Josh's cap of 25 USD matches his Yahoo value (25 USD) and is close to the 22 USD he cost in our league last season, so plan to pay about 20 to 25 USD and stop there. His assists from a forward slot and his FG% on volume are the selling points, but his high turnovers make him the best fit for a punt TO build, and his rest days plus three back-to-backs in our playoff weeks limit his weekly totals. Early in the season, check how often he sits, whether he really runs the point next to Maxey, and whether his assists move toward 8 a game.
